Question Text (English): While driving at the posted speed, you see motorcycles filtering between lanes and uneven braking ahead.
Option A: Maintain speed and brake if traffic slows suddenly
Option B: Reduce speed early and increase following distance
Option C: Change lanes to avoid slower traffic ahead
Option D: Maintain speed and focus on the vehicle ahead
Explanation (English): Reduce speed early to create time and space for sudden road changes.
Malay Question Text: Anda memandu pada kelajuan dibenarkan. Motosikal bergerak di antara lorong dan brek tidak sekata berlaku di hadapan.
Malay Option A: Kekalkan kelajuan dan brek jika trafik perlahan secara tiba-tiba
Malay Option B: Kurangkan kelajuan lebih awal dan tambah jarak kenderaan
Malay Option C: Tukar lorong untuk mengelakkan trafik perlahan
Malay Option D: Kekalkan kelajuan dan fokus pada kenderaan di hadapan
Malay Explanation: Kurangkan kelajuan lebih awal untuk memberi masa dan ruang apabila keadaan jalan berubah.

Question Text (English): You merge from a slip road onto a busy highway. Vehicles ahead brake unevenly and motorcycles pass between lanes.
Option A: Wait for a clearly safe gap before merging
Option B: Merge and adjust speed once on the highway
Option C: Use the gap quickly before traffic closes
Option D: Move forward to signal intent and merge when traffic slows
Explanation (English): Choose a safe gap to avoid sudden braking and conflict during merging.
Malay Question Text: Anda memasuki lebuh raya dari laluan masuk. Kenderaan di hadapan membrek tidak sekata dan motosikal bergerak di antara lorong.
Malay Option A: Tunggu jarak/ruang yang benar-benar selamat sebelum masuk
Malay Option B: Masuk dahulu dan ubah kelajuan di lebuh raya
Malay Option C: Gunakan ruang dengan cepat sebelum trafik menjadi padat/sesak
Malay Option D: Bergerak ke hadapan untuk beri isyarat niat dan masuk apabila trafik perlahan
Malay Explanation: Pilih jarak yang selamat untuk mengelakkan brek mengejut dan konflik semasa masuk ke lebuh raya.

Question Text (English): You need to reverse into a marked bay inside a site. Space is tight, visibility is limited, and vehicles move nearby.
Option A: Stop and reverse only when visibility and clearance are confirmed
Option B: Reverse slowly while checking mirrors and adjusting position
Option C: Continue reversing to avoid delaying vehicles behind
Option D: Reverse carefully and rely on others to keep clear
Explanation (English): Confirm visibility and clearance before reversing in confined areas.
Malay Question Text: Anda perlu mengundur ke petak bertanda di dalam tapak. Ruang sempit, pandangan terhad, dan kenderaan bergerak berhampiran.
Malay Option A: Berhenti dan undur hanya apabila pandangan dan ruang selamat dipastikan
Malay Option B: Undur perlahan sambil periksa cermin dan sesuaikan kedudukan
Malay Option C: Terus undur untuk elakkan melambatkan kenderaan di belakang
Malay Option D: Undur dengan berhati-hati dan harap orang lain menjauh
Malay Explanation: Pastikan pandangan dan ruang selamat sebelum mengundur di kawasan sempit.

Question Text (English): You approach a terminal gate where vehicles queue across multiple lanes.
Option A: Remain in the assigned lane and follow the gate process
Option B: Shift to a faster lane when another vehicle is processed
Option C: Move forward gradually as space opens ahead
Option D: Follow the vehicle ahead through the gate
Explanation (English): Remain in your lane and follow gate instructions to keep entry orderly.
Malay Question Text: Anda menghampiri pintu masuk terminal. Kenderaan beratur di beberapa lorong.
Malay Option A: Kekal di lorong yang ditetapkan dan ikut proses di pintu masuk
Malay Option B: Tukar ke lorong lebih laju apabila kenderaan lain sedang diproses
Malay Option C: Bergerak ke hadapan secara beransur-ansur apabila ruang terbuka
Malay Option D: Ikut kenderaan di hadapan melalui pintu masuk
Malay Explanation: Kekalkan lorong dan patuhi arahan pintu masuk untuk memastikan kemasukan teratur.

Question Text (English): Inside a site yard, a marshal instructs you to hold while vehicles reposition nearby.
Option A: Hold position and continue checking mirrors and blind spots
Option B: Signal and edge forward slightly to prepare to move
Option C: Adjust position gradually while watching the marshal
Option D: Follow nearby vehicles once they begin moving
Explanation (English): Follow marshal instructions while maintaining situational awareness.
Malay Question Text: Di kawasan tapak, seorang marshal mengarahkan anda supaya berhenti sementara kenderaan berhampiran sedang mengubah kedudukan.
Malay Option A: Kekal berhenti dan terus periksa cermin serta titik buta
Malay Option B: Beri isyarat dan bergerak sedikit ke hadapan sebagai persediaan bergerak
Malay Option C: Sesuaikan kedudukan secara beransur sambil memerhati marshal
Malay Option D: Ikut pergerakan kenderaan berhampiran apabila ia mula bergerak
Malay Explanation: Patuhi arahan marshal sambil kekalkan kesedaran persekitaran.

Question Text (English): You queue to mount a container onto your trailer. The vehicle ahead is still aligning and the area is congested.
Option A: Maintain spacing and wait until the mounting area is clear
Option B: Move closer to prepare once the vehicle ahead finishes
Option C: Close the gap slowly to reduce waiting time
Option D: Follow ground staff signals to approach closely
Explanation (English): Maintain spacing during container mounting operations.
Malay Question Text: Anda beratur untuk loading/offloading kontena ke atas treler. Kenderaan di hadapan masih melaras kedudukan dan kawasan sesak.
Malay Option A: Kekalkan jarak dan tunggu sehingga kawasan loading/offloading kosong
Malay Option B: Bergerak lebih dekat untuk bersedia apabila kenderaan di hadapan selesai
Malay Option C: Rapatkan jarak perlahan untuk kurangkan masa menunggu
Malay Option D: Ikut isyarat pekerja tapak untuk menghampiri sedekat mungkin
Malay Explanation: Kekalkan jarak semasa operasi loading/offloading kontena.

Question Text (English): You approach a terminal gate where entry requires credential verification. One credential is no longer valid.
Option A: Stop the entry process and report the issue
Option B: Proceed with entry and resolve the issue inside
Option C: Wait to see if the gate allows access
Option D: Continue toward the gate since the trip is scheduled
Explanation (English): Valid credentials are required before terminal entry.
Malay Question Text: Anda menghampiri pintu masuk terminal yang memerlukan pengesahan pas akses. Satu akses tidak lagi sah.
Malay Option A: Hentikan proses masuk dan laporkan masalah tersebut
Malay Option B: Teruskan masuk dan selesaikan isu di dalam terminal
Malay Option C: Tunggu untuk melihat sama ada pintu membenarkan masuk
Malay Option D: Terus menuju ke pintu masuk kerana perjalanan telah dijadualkan
Malay Explanation: Dokumen akses yang sah diperlukan sebelum memasuki terminal.

Question Text (English): At a checkpoint, you are asked to present documents and notice the delivery time was recorded inaccurately.
Option A: Present the document and clarify the timing if asked
Option B: Hand over the document without mentioning the timing
Option C: Explain verbally that the details are correct
Option D: Ask for time to update the document before presenting it
Explanation (English): Accurate documents and cooperation support smooth inspections.
Malay Question Text: Di tempat pemeriksaan, anda diminta menunjukkan dokumen dan menyedari masa penghantaran direkod tidak tepat.

Malay Option C: Jelaskan secara lisan bahawa butiran adalah betul

Malay Explanation: Dokumen yang tepat dan kerjasama membantu pemeriksaan berjalan lancar.

Question Text (English): While driving, the engine feels strained during acceleration though no warning lights appear.
Option A: Ease acceleration and monitor the condition
Option B: Maintain normal acceleration since no lights show
Option C: Increase engine output to test the response
Option D: Continue driving and act only if it worsens
Explanation (English): Respond early to unusual vehicle performance.
Malay Question Text: Semasa memandu, enjin terasa kurang responsive semasa memecut walaupun tiada lampu amaran menyala.

Malay Option B: Kekalkan pecutan kerana tiada lampu amaran
Malay Option C: Tingkatkan kuasa enjin untuk menguji tindak balas
Malay Option D: Terus memandu dan bertindak hanya jika keadaan bertambah teruk
Malay Explanation: Bertindak awal apabila prestasi kenderaan tidak biasa.

Question Text (English): During pre-trip inspection, you discover a brake defect before departure.
Option A: Proceed carefully and monitor the defect during the journey
Option B: Delay reporting until after completing the delivery
Option C: Report the defect immediately and follow required procedures
Option D: Ignore the defect to avoid operational delays
Explanation (English): Defects must be reported before departure to ensure safety and integrity.
Malay Question Text: Semasa pemeriksaan pra-perjalanan, anda menemui masalah pada brek sebelum berlepas.
Malay Option A: Teruskan dengan berhati-hati dan pantau masalah sepanjang perjalanan

Malay Option C: Laporkan masalah segera dan ikut prosedur yang ditetapkan
Malay Option D: Abaikan masalah untuk elakkan kelewatan operasi
Malay Explanation: Masalah mesti dilaporkan sebelum berlepas untuk memastikan keselamatan dan integriti.

Question Text (English): While waiting in an active loading zone, you notice cargo movement that may affect load stability.
Option A: Remain in position and allow loading to continue
Option B: Stop the process and alert site staff to address the cargo risk
Option C: Move the vehicle slightly to reduce exposure
Option D: Monitor the situation and proceed once loading appears stable
Explanation (English): Address cargo instability promptly to prevent incidents in loading areas.
Malay Question Text: Semasa menunggu di zon pemuatan aktif, anda melihat pergerakan muatan yang boleh menjejaskan kestabilan muatan.
Malay Option A: Kekal di tempat dan biarkan proses pemuatan diteruskan
Malay Option B: Hentikan proses dan maklumkan kakitangan tapak tentang risiko muatan
Malay Option C: Gerakkan kenderaan sedikit untuk mengurangkan pendedahan
Malay Option D: Pantau keadaan dan teruskan apabila pemuatan kelihatan stabil
Malay Explanation: Tangani ketidakstabilan muatan dengan segera untuk mengelakkan insiden di kawasan pemuatan.

Question Text (English): A customer questions a delivery delay and speaks to you in a frustrated tone.
Option A: Respond briefly and focus on completing the delivery
Option B: Explain the situation calmly and confirm the next steps
Option C: Defend your actions and point out factors beyond your control
Option D: Avoid discussion and direct the customer to the office
Explanation (English): Calm, clear explanation helps reduce frustration and keeps the interaction professional.
Malay Question Text: Seorang pelanggan mempersoalkan kelewatan penghantaran dan bercakap dengan nada tidak puas hati.
Malay Option A: Jawab secara ringkas dan fokus untuk selesaikan penghantaran
Malay Option B: Terangkan keadaan dengan tenang dan sahkan langkah seterusnya
Malay Option C: Pertahankan tindakan anda dan jelaskan faktor di luar kawalan
Malay Option D: Elakkan perbincangan dan arahkan pelanggan ke pejabat
Malay Explanation: Penjelasan yang tenang dan jelas membantu kurangkan ketegangan dan kekalkan profesionalisme.

Question Text (English): A colleague suggests you keep quiet about a major issue to avoid attention from management.
Option A: Explain clearly why the issue should be reported
Option B: Agree to stay quiet to keep things smooth
Option C: Avoid responding and let the matter pass
Option D: Say little and continue with your work
Explanation (English): Clear communication and honesty help prevent larger problems later.
Malay Question Text: Seorang rakan sekerja mencadangkan supaya anda berdiam diri tentang satu isu besar untuk elakkan perhatian pihak pengurusan.
Malay Option A: Jelaskan dengan terang mengapa isu itu perlu dilaporkan
Malay Option B: Setuju untuk berdiam diri supaya keadaan kekal tenang

Malay Option D: Kurangkan bercakap dan teruskan kerja anda
Malay Explanation: Komunikasi yang jelas dan jujur membantu elakkan masalah menjadi lebih besar.

Question Text (English): While parked in a public area, a bystander hints that a small payment could allow special access.
Option A: Decline politely and continue following normal procedures
Option B: Consider the request since it may avoid inconvenience to others
Option C: Delay responding and see if the situation resolves itself
Option D: Suggest discussing the matter later to keep things moving
Explanation (English): Refusing improper offers protects integrity and maintains public trust.
Malay Question Text: Semasa parkir di kawasan awam, seorang individu menyatakan bahawa bayaran kecil boleh membolehkan akses khas.

Malay Option C: Tangguhkan respons dan lihat perkembangan keadaan
Malay Option D: Cadangkan bincang perkara itu kemudian supaya urusan dapat diteruskan
Malay Explanation: Menolak tawaran yang tidak sesuai membantu kekalkan integriti dan kepercayaan orang awam.

Question Text (English): During a delivery, a culturally sensitive interaction is happening while people nearby are watching or recording.
Option A: Maintain respectful behaviour and continue professionally
Option B: Explain your actions carefully so others do not misinterpret them
Option C: Limit the interaction to avoid drawing further attention
Option D: Adjust your response to match how others expect you to behave
Explanation (English): Maintaining respectful, professional behaviour protects your image during visible interactions.
Malay Question Text: Semasa penghantaran, berlaku interaksi sensitif berkaitan budaya dan orang sekeliling sedang melihat dan merakam.

Malay Option B: Terangkan tindakan anda dengan teliti supaya tidak disalah tafsir
Malay Option C: Hadkan interaksi untuk elak menarik lebih perhatian
Malay Option D: Ubah respons anda mengikut jangkaan orang sekeliling
Malay Explanation: Sikap hormat dan profesional membantu melindungi imej anda apabila situasi diperhatikan orang lain.

Question Text (English): Traffic ahead is moving, but you keep extra distance. A customer messages asking why progress feels slow.
Option A: Maintain safe following distance and explain the situation calmly
Option B: Close the gap slightly so movement appears faster
Option C: Reassure the customer and focus on keeping pace
Option D: Ignore the message and continue driving
Explanation (English): Keeping a safe following distance while explaining the reason supports safety and customer confidence.
Malay Question Text: Trafik di hadapan bergerak, namun anda mengekalkan jarak yang lebih selamat. Pelanggan menghantar mesej bertanya mengapa pergerakan agak lambat.
Malay Option A: Kekalkan jarak selamat dan jelaskan keadaan dengan tenang
Malay Option B: Rapatkan sedikit jarak supaya pergerakan nampak lebih cepat
Malay Option C: Yakinkan pelanggan dan cuba kekalkan kelajuan trafik
Malay Option D: Abaikan mesej dan teruskan pemanduan
Malay Explanation: Mengekalkan jarak selamat sambil memberi penjelasan membantu menjaga keselamatan dan keyakinan pelanggan.

Question Text (English): You slow early after spotting a hazard ahead. The driver behind reacts angrily and closes in.
Option A: Keep your speed steady and avoid engaging
Option B: Speed up slightly to reduce pressure from behind
Option C: Brake again to show there is a hazard ahead
Option D: Gesture briefly to discourage the tailgating
Explanation (English): Maintaining steady driving and avoiding engagement helps manage hazards without escalating conflict.
Malay Question Text: Anda memperlahankan kenderaan lebih awal selepas melihat bahaya di hadapan. Pemandu di belakang bertindak marah dan merapat.

Malay Option C: Tekan brek sekali lagi untuk menunjukkan terdapat bahaya di hadapan
Malay Option D: Buat isyarat ringkas untuk menghalang tingkah laku tersebut

Question Text (English): You have worked six consecutive days and are scheduled for another duty.
Option A: Continue working if you feel fit.
Option B: Take one rest day after six working days.
Option C: Work half a day before taking leave.
Option D: Swap shifts without taking a rest day.

Malay Explanation: Ambil hari rehat yang ditetapkan selepas enam hari bekerja berturut-turut.

Question Text (English): Before starting your shift, you notice dark tint film and stickers on part of the windscreen.
Option A: Leave them since they were already installed.
Option B: Remove or report them because they may obstruct visibility.
Option C: Start driving and adjust your seating position instead.
Option D: Ignore them as long as the road ahead is visible.
Explanation (English): Address unauthorised modifications to protect visibility and vehicle safety.

Malay Explanation: Tangani pengubahsuaian tanpa kelulusan untuk menjaga penglihatan dan keselamatan kenderaan.

Question Text (English): A colleague asks to ride in your cabin as a second driver for convenience.
Option A: Allow the ride if the journey is short.
Option B: Decline unless company authorisation is given.
Option C: Allow the ride if the colleague is an employee.
Option D: Permit the ride if no customers are affected.
Explanation (English): Do not carry passengers without proper company authorisation.

Question Text (English): You are verifying the vehicle before loading cargo.

Explanation (English): Provide all relevant information for the initial response.

Malay Option A: Kongsikan maklumat yang menyokong laporan awal.
Malay Option B: Hadkan maklumat kepada fakta asas sahaja.
Malay Option C: Berikan butiran tambahan hanya jika diminta kemudian.
Malay Option D: Tunggu sehingga menyediakan laporan rasmi.
Malay Explanation: Berikan semua maklumat yang berkaitan untuk tindakan awal yang tepat.

Question Text (English): You position your vehicle in a loading area where forklifts are operating.
Option A: Move forward quickly and stop near loading
Option B: Stop at a safe distance and proceed when clear
Option C: Continue moving and rely on forklift guidance
Option D: Park as close as possible despite limited space
Explanation (English): Keep a safe distance from active loading zones to reduce collision risk.
Malay Question Text: Anda meletakkan kenderaan di kawasan memuat/memunggah barang di mana forklift sedang beroperasi.
Malay Option A: Bergerak cepat ke hadapan dan berhenti berhampiran kawasan memuat/memunggah barang
Malay Option B: Berhenti pada jarak selamat dan bergerak apabila laluan sudah jelas
Malay Option C: Terus bergerak dan bergantung pada panduan forklift
Malay Option D: Parkir sedekat mungkin walaupun ruang terhad
Malay Explanation: Kekalkan jarak selamat dari kawasan kawasan pemuatan aktif untuk mengurangkan risiko pelanggaran.

Question Text (English): You approach a busy junction. Traffic slows and visibility is partly blocked by surrounding vehicles.
Option A: Reduce speed early and prepare to stop
Option B: Maintain speed and brake only if needed
Option C: Slow slightly and move when the vehicle ahead moves
Option D: Keep moving to clear the junction quickly
Explanation (English): Reduce speed before junctions to respond safely to unexpected movement.
Malay Question Text: Anda menghampiri persimpangan yang sibuk. Trafik perlahan dan sebahagian pandangan terhalang oleh kenderaan sekeliling.
Malay Option A: Kurangkan kelajuan lebih awal dan bersedia untuk berhenti
Malay Option B: Kekalkan kelajuan dan brek hanya jika perlu
Malay Option C: Perlahankan sedikit dan bergerak apabila kenderaan di hadapan bergerak
Malay Option D: Terus bergerak untuk melepasi persimpangan dengan cepat
Malay Explanation: Kurangkan kelajuan sebelum persimpangan untuk bertindak balas dengan selamat terhadap pergerakan mengejut.

Question Text (English): You are on foot near your vehicle in an active loading area. Forklifts operate and stacked goods restrict visibility.
Option A: Keep clear of loading paths and wait until movement settles
Option B: Move closer to observe equipment movement
Option C: Walk through quickly to minimise time in the area
Option D: Stand where operators can see you and keep moving
Explanation (English): Keep clear of loading activity to avoid sudden equipment movement and blind spots.
Malay Question Text: Anda berjalan berhampiran kenderaan di kawasan pemunggahan aktif. Forklift beroperasi dan susunan barangan menghadkan pandangan.
Malay Option A: Kekal jauh dari laluan pemunggahan dan tunggu sehingga pergerakan reda
Malay Option B: Bergerak lebih dekat untuk memerhati pergerakan jentera
Malay Option C: Berjalan cepat untuk kurangkan masa di kawasan itu
Malay Option D: Berdiri di tempat pengendali boleh nampak dan terus bergerak
Malay Explanation: Kekalkan jarak dari aktiviti pemunggahan untuk elakkan pergerakan jentera mengejut dan kawasan titik buta.

Question Text (English): You drive inside an industrial site where equipment operates near the roadway.
Option A: Reduce speed early and keep extra clearance from equipment
Option B: Maintain pace and adjust if equipment enters your path
Option C: Continue slowly to pass before equipment repositions
Option D: Follow the vehicle ahead past the equipment
Explanation (English): Reduce speed early and keep clear of operating equipment.
Malay Question Text: Anda memandu di dalam kawasan industri di mana jentera beroperasi berhampiran laluan.
Malay Option A: Kurangkan kelajuan lebih awal dan kekalkan jarak daripada jentera
Malay Option B: Kekalkan kelajuan dan sesuaikan jika jentera memasuki laluan anda
Malay Option C: Terus bergerak perlahan untuk melepasi sebelum jentera beralih
Malay Option D: Ikut kenderaan di hadapan melepasi jentera
Malay Explanation: Kurangkan kelajuan lebih awal dan kekalkan jarak dari jentera beroperasi.

Question Text (English): Inside a site yard, equipment operates near your path when another vehicle cuts across.
Option A: Slow down, keep distance from equipment, and continue calmly
Option B: Adjust position to regain progress while watching equipment
Option C: Proceed steadily to clear the area quickly
Option D: Follow the vehicle ahead closely to avoid delay
Explanation (English): Maintain composure and distance near operating equipment.
Malay Question Text: Di kawasan tapak, jentera beroperasi berhampiran laluan anda dan tiba-tiba sebuah kenderaan melintas di hadapan.
Malay Option A: Perlahankan, kekalkan jarak dari jentera, dan teruskan dengan tenang
Malay Option B: Laraskan kedudukan untuk meneruskan pergerakan sambil memerhati jentera
Malay Option C: Terus bergerak untuk melepasi kawasan itu dengan cepat
Malay Option D: Ikut kenderaan di hadapan dengan rapat untuk elakkan kelewatan
Malay Explanation: Kekalkan ketenangan dan jarak selamat berhampiran jentera beroperasi.

Question Text (English): Before starting duty, you have not completed the required rest and are still under medication.
Option A: Delay starting duty and report the issue
Option B: Start the trip carefully since the route is familiar
Option C: Begin driving and stop later if you feel affected
Option D: Proceed and take rest after your shift
Explanation (English): Confirm fitness for duty before driving.
Malay Question Text: Sebelum memulakan tugas, anda belum mendapat rehat yang cukup dan masih di bawah kesan ubat.
Malay Option A: Tangguhkan tugas dan laporkan keadaan tersebut
Malay Option B: Mulakan perjalanan dengan berhati-hati kerana laluan sudah biasa
Malay Option C: Mula memandu dan berhenti kemudian jika terasa terjejas
Malay Option D: Teruskan dan ambil rehat selepas tamat syif
Malay Explanation: Pastikan kecergasan untuk bertugas sebelum memandu.

Question Text (English): At a site entrance, valid driving credentials are required. One required credential has expired.
Option A: Stop the entry process and report the issue
Option B: Complete the safety induction and resolve it later
Option C: Proceed since rules will be explained during induction
Option D: Wait to see if access is granted
Explanation (English): Valid credentials are required before site entry.
Malay Question Text: Di pintu masuk tapak, kelayakan memandu yang sah diperlukan. Satu kelayakan telah tamat tempoh.
Malay Option A: Hentikan proses masuk dan laporkan masalah tersebut
Malay Option B: Selesaikan taklimat keselamatan dan uruskan kemudian
Malay Option C: Teruskan masuk kerana peraturan akan diterangkan semasa taklimat
Malay Option D: Tunggu untuk melihat sama ada akses dibenarkan
Malay Explanation: Kelayakan yang sah diperlukan sebelum memasuki tapak.

Question Text (English): After loading at a site, procedure requires using a designated exit route.
Option A: Follow the designated exit route and site rules
Option B: Take a shorter route since no traffic is visible
Option C: Adjust your exit path to save time
Option D: Exit based on familiarity rather than instructions
Explanation (English): Follow site exit routes and movement rules.
Malay Question Text: Selepas selesai memunggah keluar di tapak, prosedur memerlukan anda menggunakan laluan keluar yang ditetapkan.
Malay Option A: Ikut laluan keluar dan peraturan pergerakan tapak
Malay Option B: Ambil laluan lebih pendek kerana tiada trafik kelihatan
Malay Option C: Laraskan laluan keluar untuk menjimatkan masa
Malay Option D: Keluar berdasarkan kebiasaan dan bukan arahan
Malay Explanation: Ikut laluan keluar dan peraturan pergerakan tapak.

Question Text (English): While manoeuvring at low speed in a confined space, you notice resistance and a faint scraping sound.
Option A: Stop and reassess clearance before continuing
Option B: Proceed slowly and rely on steering to clear the space
Option C: Apply more throttle to finish quickly
Option D: Continue and inspect the vehicle after the manoeuvre
Explanation (English): Stop when unusual resistance or sounds occur.
Malay Question Text: Semasa membuat manuver pada kelajuan rendah di ruang sempit, anda merasakan rintangan dan bunyi geseran ringan.
Malay Option A: Berhenti dan semak semula ruang sebelum meneruskan
Malay Option B: Terus bergerak perlahan dan bergantung pada stereng
Malay Option C: Tekan minyak lebih untuk menyelesaikan manuver dengan cepat
Malay Option D: Teruskan dan periksa kenderaan selepas manuver selesai
Malay Explanation: Berhenti apabila terdapat rintangan atau bunyi tidak biasa.

Question Text (English): During a rest stop, you notice rubbish and food containers inside the truck cabin.
Option A: Leave the cabin unchanged since cleanliness does not affect vehicle operation
Option B: Clean the cabin later when the schedule is less demanding
Option C: Clean and tidy the cabin immediately
Option D: Remove only items that may interfere with driving controls
Explanation (English): Maintaining cabin cleanliness supports safe operation and professional standards.
Malay Question Text: Semasa berhenti rehat, anda melihat sampah dan bekas makanan di dalam kabin lori.
Malay Option A: Biarkan kabin seperti itu kerana kebersihan tidak menjejaskan operasi kenderaan
Malay Option B: Bersihkan kabin kemudian apabila jadual kurang sibuk
Malay Option C: Bersihkan dan kemaskan kabin segera
Malay Option D: Buang hanya barang yang boleh mengganggu kawalan pemanduan
Malay Explanation: Menjaga kebersihan kabin menyokong operasi selamat dan mencerminkan profesionalisme.

Question Text (English): While reversing slowly in a tight site area, you lose clear sight of one rear corner.
Option A: Continue reversing slowly using mirrors
Option B: Stop the vehicle and reassess the situation
Option C: Turn the steering slightly and keep moving
Option D: Rely on previous experience and continue
Explanation (English): Stop when visibility is uncertain to prevent damage and protect people and property.
Malay Question Text: Semasa mengundur perlahan di kawasan tapak yang sempit, anda hilang pandangan jelas pada satu sudut belakang.
Malay Option A: Terus mengundur perlahan menggunakan cermin
Malay Option B: Berhenti dan nilai semula keadaan
Malay Option C: Pusing stereng sedikit dan terus bergerak
Malay Option D: Bergantung pada pengalaman lalu dan teruskan
Malay Explanation: Berhenti apabila pandangan tidak jelas untuk mengelakkan kerosakan dan melindungi orang serta harta benda.

Question Text (English): During unloading, site staff give instructions abruptly while you are positioning the vehicle.
Option A: Respond minimally and focus only on vehicle positioning
Option B: Acknowledge the instructions and coordinate calmly
Option C: Challenge the tone and clarify who is responsible
Option D: Proceed without engaging further
Explanation (English): Calm coordination helps tasks run smoothly, even when instructions are delivered abruptly.
Malay Question Text: Semasa memunggah muatan, kakitangan tapak memberi arahan secara tiba-tiba ketika anda sedang memposisikan kenderaan.
Malay Option A: Jawab secara minimum dan fokus pada posisi kenderaan sahaja
Malay Option B: Akui arahan tersebut dan bekerjasama dengan tenang
Malay Option C: Persoalkan nada arahan dan jelaskan siapa bertanggungjawab
Malay Option D: Teruskan tanpa melibatkan diri
Malay Explanation: Bekerjasama dengan tenang membantu kerja berjalan lancar walaupun arahan diberi secara tiba-tiba.

Question Text (English): A disagreement arises on site, and the discussion starts to become tense.
Option A: Speak calmly, acknowledge concerns, and clarify next steps
Option B: Restate your position firmly to end the discussion
Option C: Reduce interaction and wait for the situation to pass
Option D: Continue the task without engaging further
Explanation (English): Calm acknowledgement and clear steps help prevent disagreements from escalating.
Malay Question Text: Berlaku perbezaan pendapat di tapak dan perbincangan mula menjadi tegang.
Malay Option A: Bercakap dengan tenang dan jelaskan langkah seterusnya
Malay Option B: Tegaskan pendirian anda untuk tamatkan perbincangan
Malay Option C: Kurangkan interaksi dan tunggu keadaan reda
Malay Option D: Teruskan tugas tanpa melibatkan diri
Malay Explanation: Pendekatan yang tenang dan langkah yang jelas membantu elakkan keadaan menjadi lebih tegang.

Question Text (English): In a public area, a bystander becomes upset about where your vehicle is stopped.
Option A: Respond calmly, acknowledge the concern, and explain briefly
Option B: Explain in detail why the stop is necessary and allowed
Option C: Avoid engagement and continue the task to prevent escalation
Option D: Justify your position firmly so the complaint does not continue
Explanation (English): Calm acknowledgement helps ease public tension and prevents situations from escalating.
Malay Question Text: Di kawasan awam, seorang individu berasa tidak puas hati tentang lokasi kenderaan anda berhenti.
Malay Option A: Beri respons tenang, ambil maklum dan jelaskan secara ringkas
Malay Option B: Terangkan dengan terperinci mengapa berhenti di situ perlu dan dibenarkan
Malay Option C: Elakkan berinteraksi dan teruskan tugas
Malay Option D: Pertahankan posisi anda dengan tegas supaya aduan tidak berlanjutan
Malay Explanation: Respons yang tenang dan jelas membantu redakan ketegangan dan elakkan keadaan menjadi lebih serius.

Question Text (English): A customer calls you during the trip and urges you to arrive faster due to a delay.
Option A: Maintain a safe speed and explain your expected arrival time
Option B: Increase speed slightly to show effort and responsiveness
Option C: Reassure the customer and focus on reaching sooner
Option D: Shorten the conversation and continue driving as planned
Explanation (English): Maintaining safe speed while giving a clear update supports both safety and customer trust.
Malay Question Text: Seorang pelanggan menelefon semasa perjalanan dan mendesak anda tiba lebih cepat kerana berlaku kelewatan.
Malay Option A: Kekalkan kelajuan selamat dan maklumkan anggaran masa ketibaan
Malay Option B: Tambah sedikit kelajuan untuk tunjuk usaha dan responsif
Malay Option C: Yakinkan pelanggan dan cuba sampai lebih awal
Malay Option D: Pendekkan perbualan dan teruskan perjalanan seperti biasa
Malay Explanation: Kekalkan kelajuan selamat sambil beri maklumat jelas bagi menjaga keselamatan dan kepercayaan pelanggan.

Question Text (English): Traffic ahead slows sharply. You increase following distance while vehicles behind close in without warning.
Option A: Ease off early and activate brake lights to signal slowing
Option B: Maintain speed to avoid confusing drivers behind
Option C: Close the gap to match traffic flow
Option D: Brake later so others are forced to react
Explanation (English): Creating space early and signalling clearly helps others adjust safely to changing traffic conditions.
Malay Question Text: Trafik di hadapan menjadi perlahan secara mendadak. Anda menambah jarak hadapan sementara kenderaan di belakang semakin menghampiri tanpa amaran.
Malay Option A: Lepaskan pedal awal dan hidupkan lampu brek untuk memberi isyarat memperlahankan kenderaan
Malay Option B: Kekalkan kelajuan supaya tidak mengelirukan pemandu di belakang
Malay Option C: Rapatkan jarak untuk mengikut aliran trafik
Malay Option D: Tekan brek secara mengejut supaya pemandu lain terpaksa bertindak balas
Malay Explanation: Mewujudkan ruang lebih awal dan memberi isyarat dengan jelas membantu pemandu lain menyesuaikan diri dengan selamat.

Question Text (English): At a junction, you prepare to turn while another vehicle approaches from the side and appears unsure of your intention.
Option A: Signal early and complete the turn when it is safe
Option B: Roll forward slightly to indicate you intend to go
Option C: Wait longer to see how the other driver reacts
Option D: Turn once there is space to avoid delaying traffic behind
Explanation (English): Clear signalling at junctions helps other drivers understand your intention and reduces uncertainty.
Malay Question Text: Di simpang jalan, anda bersedia untuk membelok apabila sebuah kenderaan dari sisi kelihatan tidak pasti tentang niat anda.
Malay Option A: Beri isyarat awal dan belok apabila selamat
Malay Option B: Gerak sedikit ke hadapan untuk menunjukkan niat
Malay Option C: Tunggu lebih lama untuk melihat reaksi pemandu lain
Malay Option D: Belok apabila ada ruang untuk mengelakkan kelewatan di belakang
Malay Explanation: Isyarat yang jelas di simpang membantu pemandu lain memahami niat anda dan mengurangkan ketidakpastian.

Question Text (English): While driving, you notice the sun shade and stickers on the windscreen reduce your side visibility.
Option A: Continue driving carefully despite reduced visibility.
Option B: Stop at a safe location and remove or adjust the obstruction.
Option C: Reduce speed and rely more on mirrors.
Option D: Adjust your lane position to compensate for the blind area.
Explanation (English): Ensure full visibility before continuing to drive safely.
Malay Question Text: Semasa memandu, anda mendapati pelindung matahari dan pelekat pada cermin hadapan mengurangkan penglihatan sisi.
Malay Option A: Terus memandu dengan berhati-hati walaupun penglihatan berkurang.
Malay Option B: Berhenti di lokasi selamat dan tanggalkan/laraskan halangan tersebut.
Malay Option C: Kurangkan kelajuan dan lebih bergantung pada cermin sisi.
Malay Option D: Laraskan kedudukan lorong untuk mengimbangi kawasan yang terhalang.
Malay Explanation: Pastikan penglihatan jelas sepenuhnya sebelum meneruskan pemanduan.

Question Text (English): You arrive at a customer site to uncouple the trailer on uneven, soft ground.
Option A: Lower the landing legs carefully and check stability after uncoupling.
Option B: Place strong wooden planks under the landing legs before uncoupling.
Option C: Adjust the trailer position slightly to find firmer ground before uncoupling.
Option D: Ask site staff to observe the trailer during the process.
Explanation (English): Ensure stable ground support before uncoupling to prevent trailer instability.
Malay Question Text: Anda tiba di tapak pelanggan untuk membuka sambungan treler di atas permukaan tanah yang tidak rata dan lembut.
Malay Option A: Turunkan kaki sokongan dengan berhati-hati dan periksa kestabilan selepas membuka sambungan.
Malay Option B: Letakkan papan kayu yang kukuh di bawah kaki sokongan sebelum membuka sambungan.
Malay Option C: Laraskan sedikit kedudukan treler untuk mencari tanah yang lebih kukuh sebelum membuka sambungan.
Malay Option D: Minta kakitangan tapak memerhati treler semasa proses tersebut.
Malay Explanation: Pastikan sokongan tanah stabil sebelum membuka sambungan bagi mengelakkan treler menjadi tidak stabil.

Question Text (English): You are preparing to start your trip and will return later the same day.
Option A: Conduct inspection only before starting the trip.
Option B: Conduct inspection only after completing the trip.
Option C: Conduct inspections both before and after the trip.
Option D: Conduct inspection only if a defect is suspected.
Explanation (English): Perform required inspections before and after every trip.
Malay Question Text: Anda sedang bersedia untuk memulakan perjalanan dan akan kembali pada hari yang sama.
Malay Option A: Lakukan pemeriksaan sebelum memulakan perjalanan sahaja.
Malay Option B: Lakukan pemeriksaan selepas menamatkan perjalanan sahaja.
Malay Option C: Lakukan pemeriksaan sebelum dan selepas perjalanan.
Malay Option D: Lakukan pemeriksaan hanya jika terdapat tanda kerosakan.
Malay Explanation: Lakukan pemeriksaan yang ditetapkan sebelum dan selepas setiap perjalanan.

Question Text (English): The reflective string delineators are damaged and no longer reflective.
Option A: Continue if cones are available.
Option B: Replace them with compliant reflective delineators.
Option C: Use hazard lights instead.
Option D: Keep them until the next inspection cycle.
Explanation (English): Maintain compliant reflective equipment for roadside safety.
Malay Question Text: Tali delineator reflektif rosak dan tidak lagi memantulkan cahaya.
Malay Option A: Teruskan perjalanan jika kon keselamatan tersedia.
Malay Option B: Gantikan dengan delineator reflektif yang mematuhi spesifikasi.
Malay Option C: Gunakan lampu kecemasan sebagai ganti.
Malay Option D: Kekalkan penggunaannya sehingga pemeriksaan seterusnya.
Malay Explanation: Pastikan peralatan reflektif yang mematuhi spesifikasi sentiasa tersedia untuk keselamatan di tepi jalan.

Question Text (English): During inspection, you review emergency and fire equipment in the vehicle.
Option A: Check only for long-distance trips.
Option B: Ensure emergency and fire equipment is complete and valid.
Option C: Assume it is sufficient if previously used.
Option D: Check after starting the trip.
Explanation (English): Ensure emergency and fire equipment is complete and valid before driving.
Malay Question Text: Semasa pemeriksaan, anda menyemak peralatan kecemasan dan pemadam api di dalam kenderaan.
Malay Option A: Periksa hanya untuk perjalanan jarak jauh.
Malay Option B: Pastikan peralatan kecemasan dan pemadam api lengkap dan masih sah untuk digunakan.
Malay Option C: Anggap mencukupi jika pernah digunakan sebelum ini.
Malay Option D: Periksa selepas memulakan perjalanan.
Malay Explanation: Pastikan peralatan kecemasan dan pemadam api lengkap dan masih sah untuk digunakan sebelum memandu.

Question Text (English): You are dressing for your driving shift.
Option A: Wear long trousers as required.
Option B: Wear shorts if the weather is hot.
Option C: Wear track pants for comfort.
Option D: Wear any trousers only when visiting customer sites.
Explanation (English): Wear long trousers as part of required duty attire.
Malay Question Text: Anda sedang berpakaian untuk syif pemanduan.
Malay Option A: Pakai seluar panjang seperti yang ditetapkan.
Malay Option B: Pakai seluar pendek jika cuaca panas.
Malay Option C: Pakai seluar trek untuk keselesaan.
Malay Option D: Pakai apa-apa seluar hanya apabila melawat tapak pelanggan.
Malay Explanation: Pakai seluar panjang seperti yang ditetapkan semasa bertugas.

Question Text (English): As a driver, you must remain aware of the expiry and renewal dates of vehicle and operating documents.
Option A: Monitor the dates and arrange renewal before expiry.
Option B: Wait for reminders from the office.
Option C: Check the dates only during inspections.
Option D: Rely on company personnel to identify expiry.
Explanation (English): Be aware of expiry dates and renew documents before they lapse.
Malay Question Text: Sebagai seorang pemandu, anda perlu peka terhadap tarikh tamat tempoh dan pembaharuan dokumen kenderaan serta operasi.
Malay Option A: Pantau tarikh tersebut dan uruskan pembaharuan sebelum tamat tempoh.
Malay Option B: Tunggu peringatan daripada pejabat.
Malay Option C: Semak tarikh hanya semasa pemeriksaan.
Malay Option D: Bergantung kepada pegawai syarikat untuk mengenal pasti tarikh tamat tempoh.
Malay Explanation: Sentiasa peka terhadap tarikh tamat tempoh dan perbaharui dokumen sebelum tempoh sahnya berakhir.

Question Text (English): While hauling an import container from the port, you notice a dent and scratches on the container wall.
Option A: Record the damage in the gate pass before exiting the port.
Option B: Inform operations after delivery.
Option C: Record it only in the internal company form.
Option D: Proceed since the seal is intact.
Explanation (English): Record visible container damage in the gate pass before leaving the port.
Malay Question Text: Semasa membawa kontena import dari pelabuhan, anda mendapati terdapat kesan kemek dan calar pada dinding kontena.
Malay Option A: Rekodkan kerosakan pada gate pass sebelum keluar dari pelabuhan.
Malay Option B: Maklumkan bahagian operasi selepas penghantaran.
Malay Option C: Rekodkan hanya dalam borang dalaman syarikat.
Malay Option D: Teruskan perjalanan kerana seal masih dalam keadaan baik.
Malay Explanation: Rekodkan sebarang kerosakan kontena yang kelihatan pada gate pass sebelum meninggalkan pelabuhan.

Question Text (English): Before exiting the port, you compare the container number in the EIR/gate pass with the customs form and delivery note.
Option A: Proceed if the container type looks correct.
Option B: Ensure all documents show the same container number.
Option C: Check the number only at delivery point.
Option D: Rely on port staff verification.
Explanation (English): Confirm container numbers match across all documents before exit.
Malay Question Text: Sebelum keluar dari pelabuhan, anda membandingkan nombor kontena dalam EIR atau gate pass dengan borang kastam dan nota penghantaran.
Malay Option A: Teruskan perjalanan jika jenis kontena kelihatan betul.
Malay Option B: Pastikan semua dokumen menunjukkan nombor kontena yang sama.
Malay Option C: Semak nombor hanya di lokasi penghantaran.
Malay Option D: Bergantung kepada pengesahan kakitangan pelabuhan.
Malay Explanation: Pastikan nombor kontena sepadan dalam semua dokumen sebelum keluar dari pelabuhan.

Question Text (English): Before pulling a loaded export container, you inspect the seal.
Option A: Ensure the container is sealed before departure.
Option B: Proceed if the container door is locked.
Option C: Seal it later at the port.
Option D: Rely on warehouse staff confirmation.
Explanation (English): Ensure export containers are properly sealed before movement.
Malay Question Text: Sebelum menarik kontena eksport yang telah dimuatkan, anda memeriksa seal.
Malay Option A: Pastikan kontena telah dipasang seal sebelum bertolak.
Malay Option B: Teruskan perjalanan jika pintu kontena telah dikunci.
Malay Option C: Pasang seal kemudian apabila tiba di pelabuhan.
Malay Option D: Bergantung kepada pengesahan kakitangan gudang.
Malay Explanation: Pastikan kontena eksport dipasang seal dengan betul sebelum pergerakan.

Question Text (English): You are involved in a road collision.
Option A: Record the third party's vehicle type and registration number.
Option B: Record only the third party's phone number.
Option C: Take photos of the damage without recording vehicle details.
Option D: Ask someone help to record the information for you.
Explanation (English): Record vehicle type and registration details.
Malay Question Text: Anda terlibat dalam pelanggaran jalan raya.
Malay Option A: Catat jenis kenderaan dan nombor pendaftaran pihak ketiga.
Malay Option B: Catat nombor telefon pihak ketiga sahaja.
Malay Option C: Ambil gambar kerosakan tanpa merekod butiran kenderaan.

Malay Question Text: Anda menghampiri pintu keluar tapak yang bersambung dengan jalan awam. Ruang sempit dan mungkin perlu mengundur untuk melaras kedudukan.

Explanation (English): Complete documents correctly to maintain procedural compliance.

Explanation (English): Follow evacuation instructions and manage the vehicle safely.

Malay Question Text: Semasa memandu, anda merasakan getaran tidak normal dan bunyi mekanikal baharu daripada kenderaan.

Malay Question Text: Di checkpoint tapak, anda perasan ada kerosakan pada kenderaan sejurus sebelum dibenarkan bergerak.

Malay Question Text: Di pusat pemeriksaan keselamatan, kenderaan di hadapan sedang diperiksa dan pengawal memberi isyarat supaya anda bergerak lebih dekat.

Malay Question Text: Selepas memastikan keselamatan di lokasi kemalangan, apakah tindakan seterusnya?

Question Text (English): After a collision, operations asks for your location.

Malay Question Text: Selepas pelanggaran, bahagian operasi meminta lokasi anda.

Explanation (English): Maintain stable lane position and anticipate sudden movement.
Malay Question Text: Anda memandu dalam trafik berbilang lorong yang lancar. Motosikal bergerak di antara lorong dan trafik perlahan berhampiran susur keluar.

Question Text (English): You follow a slow vehicle on a busy road. Traffic flows on the adjacent lane.

Malay Question Text: Anda mengekori kenderaan perlahan di jalan sibuk. Trafik bergerak di lorong sebelah.

Malay Explanation: Kawal rasa marah dan tunggu ruang yang benar-benar selamat sebelum memotong.

Question Text (English): You are inside a terminal yard. A marshal signals you to hold while equipment moves in your path.

Explanation (English): Follow marshal instructions and keep distance from operating equipment.
Malay Question Text: Anda berada di dalam kawasan terminal. Seorang marshal memberi isyarat supaya berhenti sementara jentera bergerak di laluan anda.

Malay Option B: Bergerak sedikit ke hadapan untuk meningkatkan jarak penglihatan

Malay Explanation: Patuhi arahan marshal dan kekalkan jarak daripada jentera yang sedang beroperasi.

Question Text (English): You approach a junction inside an industrial site. Internal lanes intersect and site rules require vehicles to yield.
Option A: Slow down and follow the site junction rule
Option B: Roll forward and proceed when the path looks clear

Explanation (English): Apply site junction rules to prevent conflicts at internal intersections.
Malay Question Text: Anda menghampiri persimpangan di dalam kawasan industri. Laluan dalaman bersilang dan peraturan tapak memerlukan kenderaan memberi laluan.

Malay Option B: Bergerak perlahan dan masuk apabila laluan kelihatan jelas
Malay Option C: Masuk sedikit ke persimpangan untuk memberi isyarat niat

Malay Explanation: Patuhi peraturan persimpangan tapak untuk mengelakkan konflik di persimpangan dalaman.

Question Text (English): You drive inside a container terminal. RTGs and reach stackers operate nearby and containers restrict visibility.
Option A: Reduce speed early and proceed cautiously

Explanation (English): Reduce speed near operating terminal equipment.
Malay Question Text: Anda memandu di dalam terminal kontena. RTG dan reach stacker beroperasi berhampiran dan kontena menghadkan pandangan.

Malay Option B: Kekalkan kelajuan biasa dan bergantung pada pengendali untuk memberi laluan
Malay Option C: Tambah kelajuan seketika untuk melepasi kawasan itu

Malay Explanation: Kurangkan kelajuan berhampiran jentera terminal yang beroperasi.

Question Text (English): During a roadside inspection, an officer approaches and you realise you are not wearing a safety vest.

Explanation (English): Wear required safety equipment during inspections.
Malay Question Text: Semasa pemeriksaan di tepi jalan, seorang pegawai menghampiri dan anda sedar anda tidak memakai vest keselamatan.

Malay Explanation: Pakai peralatan keselamatan yang diperlukan semasa pemeriksaan.

Question Text (English): While driving inside a site, you encounter uneven surfaces and hazards along the route. You are within the speed limit.
Option A: Reduce speed to suit the hazards

Explanation (English): Adjust speed to suit conditions even within the limit.
Malay Question Text: Semasa memandu di dalam tapak, anda menghadapi permukaan tidak rata dan bahaya di laluan. Anda masih dalam had laju dibenarkan.

Malay Option D: Teruskan pada kelajuan biasa dan bergantung pada kawalan stereng
Malay Explanation: Sesuaikan kelajuan mengikut keadaan walaupun masih dalam had laju.

Question Text (English): After a pre-trip inspection, the vehicle behaves differently once you begin moving.
Option A: Continue driving to see if it settles
Option B: Stop safely and reassess the vehicle
Option C: Adjust driving style to compensate
Option D: Complete the trip and report later
Explanation (English): Vehicle behaviour should match inspection results.
Malay Question Text: Selepas pemeriksaan sebelum perjalanan, kenderaan menunjukkan keadaan tidak biasa apabila anda mula bergerak.
Malay Option A: Terus memandu untuk melihat sama ada keadaan kembali normal

Malay Explanation: Jika kenderaan menunjukkan keadaan tidak biasa, berhenti dan periksa semula sebelum meneruskan perjalanan.

Question Text (English): While preparing for delivery, you notice the cargo is not fully secured and the customer is waiting.
Option A: Pause and secure the cargo before proceeding

Option C: Proceed to avoid delay and handle carefully

Explanation (English): Secure cargo before delivery despite time pressure.
Malay Question Text: Semasa bersedia untuk penghantaran, anda mendapati muatan tidak dikunci dengan sempurna dan pelanggan sedang menunggu.

Malay Option C: Teruskan untuk mengelakkan kelewatan dan kendalikan dengan berhati-hati

Malay Explanation: Pastikan muatan selamat sebelum meneruskan penghantaran walaupun terdapat tekanan masa.

Question Text (English): Before entering an industrial site, you have not completed the required pre-trip inspection.
Option A: Enter the site carefully and complete checks later
Option B: Complete the inspection and follow site entry rules
Option C: Rely on previous checks and proceed as directed
Option D: Ask site staff to guide you inside immediately
Explanation (English): Complete inspections before site entry to ensure readiness and compliance.
Malay Question Text: Sebelum memasuki tapak industri, anda belum melengkapkan pemeriksaan pra-perjalanan kenderaan.
Malay Option A: Masuk ke tapak dengan berhati-hati dan lakukan pemeriksaan kemudian
Malay Option B: Lengkapkan pemeriksaan dan patuhi peraturan kemasukan tapak

Malay Explanation: Lengkapkan pemeriksaan sebelum memasuki tapak untuk memastikan kesiapsiagaan dan pematuhan.

Question Text (English): While waiting inside a confined site area, the vehicle is idling near structures and pedestrians.
Option A: Keep the engine idling so you can move off quickly

Option C: Keep idling until instructed to move

Explanation (English): Switching off the engine when stationary reduces risk and unnecessary exposure in confined areas.
Malay Question Text: Semasa menunggu di kawasan tapak yang sempit, enjin masih hidup berhampiran struktur dan pejalan kaki.

Malay Option B: Matikan enjin semasa menunggu

Malay Option D: Kekal berhenti dengan enjin masih hidup
Malay Explanation: Matikan enjin semasa berhenti untuk kurangkan risiko dan pendedahan.

Question Text (English): During a delivery, a customer begins recording your interaction on a mobile phone.

Option D: Proceed with the delivery without acknowledging the recording
Explanation (English): Maintaining professional behaviour protects your image when interactions are visible or recorded.
Malay Question Text: Semasa penghantaran, seorang pelanggan mula merakam interaksi anda menggunakan telefon bimbit.
Malay Option A: Teruskan perbincangan dengan tenang dan profesional
Malay Option B: Minta pelanggan berhenti merakam sebelum meneruskan
Malay Option C: Jawab secara ringkas dan fokus untuk selesaikan tugas

Malay Explanation: Kekalkan tingkah laku profesional apabila interaksi dirakam atau dilihat orang lain.

Question Text (English): During unloading, a disagreement with site staff begins to escalate over the unloading sequence.

Explanation (English): Pausing and responding calmly helps defuse tension.
Malay Question Text: Semasa proses memunggah, berlaku perbezaan pendapat dengan kakitangan tapak mengenai turutan memunggah muatan dan keadaan mula menjadi tegang.
Malay Option A: Berhenti seketika dan bincang dengan tenang
Malay Option B: Terangkan dengan panjang lebar mengapa turutan anda lebih betul dan selamat
Malay Option C: Teruskan proses memunggah secara senyap untuk elak keadaan menjadi lebih tegang
Malay Option D: Pertahankan cara anda supaya semua faham sebabnya
Malay Explanation: Berhenti seketika dan beri respons dengan tenang membantu redakan ketegangan.

Question Text (English): After unloading, someone pressures you to change delivery records so the issue does not escalate.
Option A: Say the records must stay as they are and continue calmly

Explanation (English): Keeping records accurate while staying calm helps prevent conflict from escalating.
Malay Question Text: Selepas proses memunggah, seseorang menekan anda supaya mengubah rekod penghantaran agar isu tersebut tidak menjadi lebih besar.
Malay Option A: Nyatakan rekod mesti kekal seperti sedia ada dan teruskan dengan tenang

Malay Option C: Biarkan rekod dahulu untuk elak pertelingkahan lanjut

Malay Explanation: Kekalkan rekod yang tepat sambil bersikap tenang untuk elakkan keadaan menjadi lebih tegang.

Question Text (English): While driving through a community area, people nearby gesture for you to slow down as you pass.

Malay Question Text: Semasa melalui kawasan komuniti, orang di sekitar memberi isyarat supaya anda memperlahankan kenderaan.

Question Text (English): In a local area, another driver gestures courteously for you to merge while traffic slows.

Malay Question Text: Kenderaan barangan anda mengalami kerosakan di lebuh raya dan anda sedang meletakkan kon keselamatan di belakangnya.

Question Text (English): During inspection, you realise the vehicle has no working torchlight.

Question Text (English): Before starting a trip, you check the prime mover and trailer documents.

Malay Question Text: Anda mendapati terdapat kerosakan pada kontena dan tidak pasti sama ada muatan di dalamnya terjejas.
